name: sfi
description: Read-only access to your own SoFi Checking & Savings balances, transactions, interest and statements, through the open-source sfi CLI.
long_description: Ask Claude about your SoFi Checking & Savings: what each account holds and their total, what you spent and received over a period, how much interest a year paid (the 1099-INT figure), and which monthly statements exist. Four read-only tools, sofi_balances, sofi_transactions, sofi_interest and sofi_documents; nothing can move money or change your account. The extension asks for no password: SoFi sign-in is through a browser, so first install the sfi CLI and run `sfi auth login --browser` in a terminal. That stores the session in your OS keychain, and the bundled sfi reads it from there. On macOS the first call asks for keychain access; choose Always Allow. Unofficial; not affiliated with SoFi.

tools.name: sofi_balances
tools.description: Each open account's balance and APY, and their total.

tools.name: sofi_transactions
tools.description: Settled transactions over a date range: spending, deposits and payments.

tools.name: sofi_interest
tools.description: Interest paid in a calendar year, by account.

tools.name: sofi_documents
tools.description: Monthly statements on file (listed, not downloaded).
